articles.title: The National Police accuses Nucleo Nacional of training in Ukraine to prepare an "armed uprising"
articles.description: The National Police have confirmed that the militants of Núcleo Nacional who were arrested last Friday traveled to Ukraine last August to receive paramilitary training, use weapons of war, and establish ties with other like-minded organizations with the goal of preparing for what they called an "armed uprising" in Spain. This is stated in the summary, first reported by Efe, incorporated into the investigation being conducted by the Gijón investigating court number 1, which last Friday ordered the simultaneous arrest of 14 people and several raids in Asturias, Madrid, Guadalajara, Burgos, Alicante, Pontevedra, and Valladolid.

articles.title: World : 10 Police Personnel Killed In Militant Attack In NW Pakistan
articles.description: ISLAMABAD, Nov 11 (Bernama-Xinhua) -- At least 10 police personnel were killed in a militant attack on their convoy in Pakistan's northwest Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province on Wednesday, police sources said, reported Xinhua.
